content.value: The energy of formation of a vacancy in the aluminum (Al) crystal is about 0.70 eV. Calculate the fractional concentration of vacancies in Al at room temperature, 300 K, and very close to its melting temperature 660 °C. What is the vacancy concentration at 660 °C given that the atomic concentration in Al is about $6 . 0 \times 1 0 ^ { 2 2 } \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 3 } ?$
